description: Test-account fixture for the classification footnote in docs/Senseml reference/concepts/file-types.md. Sensible classifies by the doc type's description, so it describes the test spreadsheets in this folder: one commission statement as CSV, XLSX, XLS, XLSM (made from the CSV with make_spreadsheets.py), and XLSB (converted from the XLSX with SheetJS; see make_spreadsheets.py). The config has no fields: classification doesn't use it, but every fixture needs one, plus a reference document, so you can open it in the SenseML editor. Paths are relative to this folder; a reference document is either `file` (in this folder) or `docs_pdf` (a file name in assets/pdfs/, used in place).
